description: The RFC 7517 A.3 set by alg HS256 returns its HMAC key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.2 (JWK alg): member 0's alg A128KW is not HS256, and member 1 has no alg; both are oct (§2.1), neither has use or key_ops, and the selector has no kid; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose

keys.kid: HMAC key used in JWS spec Appendix A.1 example

jwk.kid: HMAC key used in JWS spec Appendix A.1 example
